svg.text: MULTI-REGION ACTIVE-ACTIVE LLM HA/DR: GEO-STICKY PREFIX AFFINITY & 1.8S FAILOVER
Active-Active Geo-Sticky Routing + Prefix Warm-Sync + Escape Hatch Hits 99.99% SLA & 1.8s RTO
120-RPS Global Enterprise Platform: Tier 1 Cold Pilot-Light (2,400s RTO) vs. Tier 2 Hot Standby ($460K/mo) vs. Tier 4 ($192K/mo)
⛔ Tier 1 & 2 Traps: `OutOfStock` & KV Cold-Storm
1. Why "Pilot-Light On-Demand GPU Scale-Up" Fails in Real Outages:
• When a primary cloud region fails, thousands of tenants request
H100/H200 in the backup region simultaneously (`88.5%` OutOfStock!)
2. The Failover `KV Cache Cold-Storm` Cascading Outage (`34.2%` Drop):
• Dumping 120 RPS of `16K` multi-turn sessions onto a cold Region B
cluster (`0%` KV hit rate) triggers a `4.5x` Prefill FLOPs storm!
3. 100% Idle Hot-Standby GPU Waste (`$460,000 / Month`):
• Paying for a duplicate idle GPU cluster in Region B doubles TCO
Tier 1 (Cold DR) & Tier 2 (Idle Hot Standby) Impact:
• Tier 1 Cold DR RTO: 2,400s (40m) | OutOfStock Drop: 88.5%
• Tier 2 Idle Hot Standby: $460K/mo, 34.2% KV Cold-Storm Drop!
• Annual Effective Availability: 99.15% (Tier 1) / 99.82% (Tier 2)
🏆 Tier 4: Active-Active Geo-Sticky + Escape Hatch
1. Active-Active Geo-Sticky Routing (`50% East / 50% West` + Batch):
• Both regions serve live traffic (`60%` online + `40%` preemptible
batch/SFT buffer); pins each `session_id` to its home region!
2. Async Top-Prefix Warm Sync + Brownout Context Cap (`0%` Storm):
• Pre-warms top-100 system/RAG prefixes in both regions & evicts
Region B batch jobs in `4.2s` (`vLLM wake_up`) during failover!
3. 3-Tier Escape Hatch (`Region A -> Region B -> Multi-Cloud PAYGO`):
• Absorbs overflow bursts on cross-cloud Serverless APIs (`1.8s` RTO)
Tier 4 Verified Production Benchmarks:
• Regional Outage RTO: 1.8 sec | Cascading Drop Rate: 0.0%
• Annual Effective Availability: 99.99% (<52m downtime/year)
• Monthly Global HA/DR TCO: $192,000 / mo (-58.3% vs. Tier 2)
